NRL Official Anasta Resigns Amid Conflict of Interest Crackdown

NRL commissioner Kate Anasta has resigned from her position, becoming the first casualty of a new crackdown on conflicts of interest within the sport's administration. The resignation follows concerns raised about potential conflicts of interest among officials. The National Rugby League (NRL) has initiated measures to address these issues, with Anasta's departure marking the initial consequence of this policy enforcement. Further details regarding the specific conflicts or the broader scope of the crackdown were not provided in the coverage.
